hooks.name: Command Deny List
hooks.description: Blocks execution of dangerous or restricted shell commands by checking them against a deny list before they run.

action.prompt: Check if the command about to be executed contains any of these denied patterns: 'rm -rf', 'chmod 777', 'curl | sh', 'curl |sh', 'wget | sh', 'wget |sh'. If it matches any denied pattern, respond with 'ACCESS DENIED: This command is on the deny list.' and do NOT proceed. If it does not match, proceed normally.
